entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I just need to return something.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and I can help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins, order 774-B-91. I need to return the cycling shoes.

Okay, Sarah, I have your order pulled up. I'm sorry to hear the shoes didn't work out. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, David, I don't have time for a survey. They gave me horrible blisters. The cleats are fine, the shoes just don't fit my feet. I need a refund.
I understand completely, getting blisters is no good. Let me just check the purchase date... okay. I see the order was delivered 63 days ago.
And? Your policy is 90 days. Can you process this or not?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this return for a full refund right now. I've just emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Just box up the cycling shoes and drop them off.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
